title: Smishing to Credential Theft
briefing: SYNTHETIC DRILL. Multiple employees report a text claiming to be IT support asking them to re-verify their login. One employee clicked the link.

feed.text: Helpdesk ticket: employee clicked link in SMS from 'IT-Support'
Login from unfamiliar ASN for user j.rivera
2 more reports of the same SMS

actions.label: Block the phishing domain at the gateway
Force password reset + revoke sessions for j.rivera
Reply to the SMS asking if it's legit
actions.why: Engaging the attacker confirms the number is active and wastes time.

actions.label: Email all customers about a breach
actions.why: No evidence of customer data exposure yet; premature notices cause panic and can themselves look like phishing.

tips: Contain the source before investigating scope.
Reset credentials before notifying anyone externally.
